0|39f53292181081d35174a581a98441de5da22bc9|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"platform/x86: thinkpad_acpi: Fix WWAN device disabled issue after S3 deep
When WWAN device wake from S3 deep
WWAN would be disabled. This disable status could be checked
by command 'nmcli r wwan' or 'rfkill list'.
Issue analysis as below:
When host resume from S3 deep
call hotkey_resume() function. Finnaly
wan_get_status to check the current status of WWAN device.
During this resume progress
return off even WWAN boot up completely.
In patch V2
after a suspend/resume. It's better to drop the
tpacpi_rfk_update_swstate call all together from the
resume path'.
And it's confimed by Lenovo that GWAN is no longer
available from WHL generation because the design does not
match with current pin control.
